# Apex Qubits

> Apex Qubits designs superconducting quantum processors, robust by design: standalone packaged chips, tested, with test data and root access.

## Key facts
- What we make: superconducting quantum processors, robust by design
- Delivered as: standalone packaged chips in a sample holder, for standard hardware
- Delivered with: test data and root access
- For: labs and industrial companies, such as quantum startups; then research centers
- Target: quantum error correction; the same processors serve other research that needs good qubits; in the long run, an Apex processor inside every future quantum data center
- Stage: pre-incorporation; first processor-level demonstrator in preparation
- Funding: grants for now; plans to raise soon
- Support for our processor work: CNRS pre-maturation program, decision of 7 May 2026
- Founder and CEO: Vladimir Milchakov, PhD
- Co-founder: Cyril Mori, PhD
- Scientific Advisor: Olivier Buisson, PhD
- Contact: info@apexqubits.com
